code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    for c in range(w):
        if grid[h-1][c] != 5: continue
        seeds=[(r,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]!=0]
        for (a,va),(b,vb) in zip(seeds,seeds[1:]):
            # Partition at the midpoint, assigning a midpoint row to the lower seed.
            boundary=(a+b+1)//2
            for r in range(a+1,b):
                out[r][c]=va if r<boundary else vb
        for r in range(seeds[0][0]): out[r][c]=seeds[0][1]
        for r in range(seeds[-1][0]+1,h): out[r][c]=seeds[-1][1]
    return out
'''
